records.title: GraphESMStable: A Deep Learning Framework for Protein Stability Prediction Fusing Pre-trained Sequence Models and Graph Neural Networks
records.reason: GraphESMStable predicts protein stability from pretrained sequence and graph models; it does not address LLM inference cost or serving.

records.title: Robust Reasoning as a Symmetry-Protected Topological Phase
records.reason: The paper proposes a conceptual topological account of robust reasoning and semantic-noise sensitivity. It does not report a concrete compute, memory, latency, or serving method.

records.title: Breaking the Speed-Accuracy Trade-Off: A Novel Embedding-Based Framework with Coarse Screening-Refined Verification for Zero-Shot Named Entity Recognition
records.reason: Primary MDPI article https://doi.org/10.3390/computers15010036 could not be opened. Abstract describes coarse screening/refined verification for efficient zero-shot NER, but detailed latency/quality trade-offs and limitations are unavailable.

records.title: Revisiting Data Compression with Language Modeling
records.reason: The report evaluates LLMs as general data compressors, including text, code, and byte sequences, and reports adjusted compression rates. The LLM is being used as the compressor; the work does not reduce LLM inference cost or improve LLM serving.

records.title: Beyond LLaVA-HD: Diving Into High-Resolution Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: Primary IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2026.3650761 was inaccessible. Abstract describes reducing visual tokens and computation in high-resolution MLLMs, but the full method, evaluation, and limitations could not be checked.
